lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; f4952 p. 3, Who Must File, 'you must file Form 4952 to claim a deduction for your investment interest expense. Exception. You don't have to file Form 4952 if all of the following apply ...', and p. 4, Line 4g, 'To make the election, enter on line 4g the amount you elect to include in investment income'. The reply omits the election: an amount on line 4g is made only on the form, so the form must be filed even when the exception's three conditions hold; it also requires f4952.has_interest where the project requires line 3 above zero, which differ only when has_interest is Yes with no 2025 interest and no carryover (no interest to claim, so the form is not required). The same disagreement was ruled model error under the earlier subject; this pass's subject changed only through the f4952.carryover wording (BUG-0833 part 2) and the new f4952.royalty_held refusal on line 4a. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; equivalent: f4952 p. 1, line 2, 'Disallowed investment interest expense from 2024 Form 4952, line 7'. The reply reads f4952.carryover ungated; the project asks it only under f4952.has_interest, whose question ('In 2025 or an earlier year, did you ... pay interest on money borrowed to buy investments', help 'Interest of an earlier year counts only if you could not deduct all of it then') covers any carryforward, so a carryover can only be Yes after that parent is Yes, and both give $0 otherwise. The reworded f4952.carryover and f4952.prior_7 (line 7 of a 2024 Form 4952 or what a correct one would show) change the question's reach, not the line's expression. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; the candidate reads f1040.line3a whatever box 1a is above zero, so it needs that answer where the source does not: i1040gi p. 25, Line 3a, "Qualified dividends are also included in the ordinary dividend total required to be shown on line 3b": with box 1a (line 3b) zero, line 3a is zero. The project reads the gate line f1040.line3a_if_ordinary, which takes f1040.line3a when box 1a is above zero holds and zero otherwise; the interview asks f1040.line3a only then (gated_by f1040.line3a_if_ordinary), so on every return the interview can produce with the condition true the two sides agree. Ruled by reading: the scoped reply names interfaces the candidate bank does not resolve, as in the earlier line-scoped passes of this lane.

Ruling: representation; same as the backlog-round ruling (line, candidate and evidence unchanged). f4952 p. 3, Line 4d: "Net gain from the disposition of property held for investment is the excess, if any, of your total gains over your total losses". Form 1040 line 7a floored at zero is Schedule D line 16 floored at zero on every return the project computes. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f4952.json`, refresh round; 1,565 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 194 partial records): 2,259 of 2,259 agree.

Ruling: model error; same as the backlog-round ruling. f4952 p. 3, Line 4e: "the excess, if any, of your net long-term capital gain over your net short-term capital loss". Both branches of the candidate give the project's amount (no value difference); its refusal at line 4e on f4952.alternative_allocation reaches returns that do not use the form. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f4952.json`, refresh round; 1,565 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 194 partial records): 2,074 of 2,259 agree; on completed returns 20 candidate-unknown, 4 candidate-refuses, no value. The screen pattern of the earlier rounds holds: every completed-return refusal or unknown is on a return that does not use Form 4952 (line 1 $0, no 2024 carryforward, no line 4g election), where the candidate still asks or refuses on f4952.unsupported or f4952.alternative_allocation, answers the source does not need (prior ruling, backlog round, checked on the recorded witnesses: e.g. classm.clcw.2.deepseek refused on f4952.alternative_allocation, classm.s3.2.deepseek unknown).

Ruling: representation; triage 2,600/2,730 agree; 21 value differences (3 on completed returns), each with f4952.has_interest No and an f4952.line4g answer present in the record (e.g. generated 465: line 4g $9,163.89 with no investment interest): line 4g is asked only beneath has_interest Yes (gated_by f4952.line4g_if_interest), so that answer is never collected and the project's election is 0. The reply sums the raw input. Where line 4g is asked the two agree; the project also refuses an election above lines 4b plus 4e (f4952 line 4g, "don't enter more than the sum of lines 4b and 4e"). f4952 line 4h, "Add lines 4c, 4f, and 4g".

Ruling: representation; equivalent: f4952 p. 1, line 8, the smaller of lines 3 and 6. The project gives $0 when Form 4952 is not used (line 1 and line 4g at $0 and no carryover), where line 3 is $0 and the smaller of lines 3 and 6 is $0 as well. The reply's note that royalty-related parts are refused through f4952.unsupported is now also enforced mechanically by f4952.royalty_held on line 4a, which line 8 reads through line 6. Project stands.
